title: grindelia ciliata
intro: Grindelia ciliata, commonly known as gumweed, is a plant species in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which make it beneficial in treating various health issues such as fever, bronchitis, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Grindelia ciliata include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
